Photo 1 shows the front view of the cooker with oven door closed. The brand 'Scaatrol' is visible on the top left and bottom center of the oven door. The unit has five control knobs and a silver handle.
Photo 2 shows the top view of the gas cooktop with four burners. The left front burner has visible rust and discoloration. The brand 'Scaatrol' is visible on the front panel below the cooktop.
The cooktop surface is stainless steel with black grates. The oven door has a glass window with a black frame.
The unit appears to be freestanding with a silver and black color scheme.
